verdict.rationale: Shortwave's Splits divide one inbox into multiple focused inboxes, each in its own tab, so different types of email can be handled at different times. AI filters can automatically label mail, and community users praise its Bundles grouping, which together support priority-order triage. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the specific streams named (team, newsletters, calendar invites), detail on how splits are configured or ordered by priority, and hands-on corroboration of Splits specifically (as opposed to Bundles).
